title: Fine-Tuning Language Models from Human Preferences
authors: D. Ziegler, N. Stiennon, J. Wu, T. Brown, A. Radford, D. Amodei, P. Christiano, G. Irving
before: Preference-based RL had been shown on robotics and games, not language.
problem: Language generation has no reward signal, and likelihood is a poor proxy for what people want.
breakthrough: Apply the reward-model-plus-RL recipe to fine-tuning a language model, on GPT-2.
why: The bridge between the 2017 RLHF idea and the assistants of 2022. Everything after is refinement and scale.
next: Summarisation from human feedback in 2020, then InstructGPT in 2022.
inherits: The three-stage pipeline: pretrain, learn a reward model, optimise the policy.
